name: @pipeworx/mcp-defillama

tools.name: defi_tvl_protocols
tools.description: Search DeFi protocols by name or category to compare their total value locked. Returns protocol name, TVL amount, blockchain, and category.

search.description: Filter protocols by name (case-insensitive substring match)

tools.name: defi_protocol_detail
tools.description: Get detailed metrics for a specific DeFi protocol including TVL history over time, breakdown by blockchain, and token information.

tools.name: defi_chain_tvl
tools.description: Compare total value locked across all blockchains. Returns TVL per chain to identify where capital is concentrated.

tools.name: defi_protocol_fees
tools.description: Check daily fees and revenue for a DeFi protocol. Returns fee trends to analyze profitability and income changes over time.

tools.name: defi_revenue_ranking
tools.description: Rank DeFi protocols by revenue (or fees) over the last 24h, 7d or 30d, with the change versus the prior period. Answers "top DeFi protocols by 30-day revenue" and "which protocols' revenue grew most". Filter by category (e.g. "Dexs", "Lending", "Liquid Staking") and/or chain. Each row: protocol slug, category, chains, revenue for the period, prior-period revenue, percent change, 24h/7d/30d totals and all-time total (USD). Source: DefiLlama, fees and revenue dataset. Pass a returned slug to defi_protocol_fees for the daily series.

data_type.description: Rank by revenue (default) or gross fees.

sort_by.description: "value" (default) ranks by period revenue; "change" ranks by percent change vs the prior period (protocols with under $10k prior-period revenue excluded).

tools.name: defi_stablecoins
tools.description: Get stablecoin market cap and distribution across blockchains. Returns supply per chain to track adoption and network preferences.

tools.name: defi_yields
tools.description: Find yield opportunities across DeFi pools filtered by project name, minimum TVL, or minimum APY. Returns APY, TVL, and project details.

search.description: Filter by project name (case-insensitive substring match)

tools.name: defi_token_unlocks
tools.description: Crypto token UNLOCK calendar from DefiLlama: every scheduled vesting cliff and emission-rate change across ~370 tracked tokens in a date window (e.g. "which token unlocks are scheduled this week", "unlocks over $10M between 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-12"). Returns per event: date, token, tokens unlocked, USD value at the current DefiLlama price (with the price time), share of circulating supply, and the recipients (investors, team, ecosystem…). Default window is today through 7 days out.

from.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC, inclusive). Default: today.

to.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC, inclusive). Default: from + 7 days.

min_usd.description: Only cliff unlocks worth at least this many USD at the current price (e.g. 1000000). Excludes emission-rate changes, which have no single USD amount.

token.description: Restrict to tokens whose name, symbol or DefiLlama slug contains this text (e.g. "hyperliquid", "ARB").

limit.description: Max events returned, sorted by date then USD value (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: defi_token_emission
tools.description: One crypto token's full vesting / EMISSION SCHEDULE from DefiLlama (e.g. "Hyperliquid HYPE unlock schedule", "when do Arbitrum team tokens vest"). Returns max supply, allocation by category (insiders, airdrop, staking…) with % unlocked so far, per-recipient unlocked-now vs final amounts, the dated unlock events (past and upcoming, with USD value at the current price), and DefiLlama's methodology notes.

protocol.description: DefiLlama protocol slug or name (e.g. "hyperliquid", "arbitrum", "aptos", "sui"). Unknown names return close matches.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-defillama forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the defillama pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
